institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Seasonal unavailability of fruits and the need to preserve their high quality and eating characteristics year-round.
description: A process combining osmotic dehydration and dehumidified drying to produce high-quality dry fruits. The technology processes raw fruit with sugar syrup using a jacketed kettle, RADD, and vacuum packaging to ensure product availability throughout the year.
applications: • Manufacturing of premium shelf-stable fruit snacks • Production of commercial ice cream and confectionery toppings • Processing of year-round fruit preservation bases • Deployment in post-harvest agricultural value-addition units
secondary_sector: Consumer & Lifestyle Products, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
